description: Phase-05 fair classical baselines for E2 (mrsr): B0 classical and ideal-quantum reservoirs (in-run anchors) and the tuned ESN (B4), each with linear ridge and RBF kernel ridge (B2b); 8 configurations, full-n kernels. Independent controls, not the paper's method.

experiment._comment_reservoir_types: classical = ReservoirPy defaults (paper baseline B0); quantum_ideal = ideal quantum reservoir; esn_tuned = B4, the same ReservoirPy reservoir with spectral radius, leak rate and input scaling tuned on the eval split (12 settings).
